title: Taylor Swift’s Wedding Doubles as a Once-in-a-Lifetime Concert From Paul McCartney & Stevie Nicks
summary: On the new Billboard Pop Shop Podcast, Katie & Keith are talking about everything we know about what went down in Madison Square Garden.
tags: Pop Shop Podcast - New Every Tuesday
contentText:
When Taylor Swift curates a concert, it’s legends only.

While Swift’s July 3 nuptials to Travis Kelce have been pretty successfully kept under wraps — including any photos of the bride and groom on their wedding day — a couple of musical details have crept out, including that Stevie Nicks performed at the ceremony and that Paul McCartney played a Beatles song he hasn’t done since 1964. According to People , McCartney performed “I Want to Hold Your Hand” for the first time in more than 60 years.

On the new Billboard Pop Shop Podcast , Katie & Keith are talking about the details we’ve learned from the big day and what (if anything) we might see of photos or videos from inside New York’s Madison Square Garden.

Also on the show, we’ve got chart news on how ATEEZ notch their third No. 1 on the Billboard 200 albums chart, and how the act becomes the group with the most top 10s on the chart this decade. Plus, on the Billboard Hot 100, as Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas” stays put at No. 1, the latest singles from sombr, Gracie Abrams and Benson Boone are the top debuts of the week. Katie & Keith also talk about our first impressions of Madonna’s Confessions II album, which will impact next week’s Billboard charts.

The  Billboard  Pop Shop Podcast  is your one-stop shop for all things pop on  Billboard ‘s weekly charts. You can always count on a lively discussion about the latest pop news, fun chart stats and stories, new music, and guest interviews with music stars and folks from the world of pop. Casual pop fans and chart junkies can hear  Billboard ‘s executive digital director, West Coast, Katie Atkinson and  Billboard ’s managing director, charts and data operations, Keith Caulfield every week on the podcast, which can be streamed on Billboard.com or  downloaded in Apple  Podcasts  or your favorite podcast provider. ( Click here to listen to the previous edition of the show  on Billboard.com.)
